title: Lightweight provenance ledger for routing policy decisions and model-variant fallbacks
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: As requests traverse smart routing policies (region selection, tier routing, fallback to model variants) we lack a compact, queryable provenance record that: (1) attributes per-hop latency and token-cost to routing decisions, (2) preserves enough context to replay or reason about fallbacks, and (3) stays storage- and ingestion-cost friendly for high-traffic customers.

Goal: Implement a lightweight provenance ledger that records one append-only 'decision envelope' per routed request (sampled), with per-hop micro-metrics (latency, estimated token cost, model variant id, region, tier), deterministic identifiers for joinability with traces and request logs, and an enrichment/compaction pipeline that produces: (a) full fidelity snapshots for sampled requests, and (b) compact deltas for aggregate SLO/cost dashboards.

Non-goals: This ticket does not replace full request logs or trace-level span debugging for rare incidents. It also does not define new escape-hatch routing behavior — only observability artifacts for existing policies.
acceptance_criteria: Append-only decision envelope generated for >=90% of sampled routed requests and writable to provenance Kafka topic

Envelope schema includes: request_id, routing_id, hop_index, selected_region, selected_tier, model_variant, hop_latency_ms, estimated_token_cost, kv_cache_hit(boolean), fallback_reason (nullable), deterministic_join_id
Joinable with existing OpenTelemetry traces via deterministic_join_id and instrumented tracer attributes
Dashboard panels showing per-hop latency stack, cumulative estimated token cost by route, and fallback-rate heatmap across regions and tiers
End-to-end test that simulates region outage and verifies fallbacks are recorded with fallback_reason and per-hop metrics
Storage budget: steady-state additional storage growth from provenance envelopes < 10% of existing request logs after compaction for default sampling (1%)
updates: 2026-02-22 — Initial spike: validated envelope shape with runtime team. Chose UUIDv7-based deterministic_join_id seeded by routing decision hash to make joins without tracing correlation headers.

2026-02-27 — Prototype: added instrumentation hook in router service to emit 'decision.envelope' to Kafka topic 'prov.envelopes.v1'. Prototype emits full context for 1/100 sampled requests. Early test shows 60ms additional tail on router in worst-case when serializing full payload; moving serialization to background worker reduces impact to <5ms median.

2026-03-03 — Trade-off review with infra: storage vs fidelity. Decided on two-tier retention: full-snapshot partitions (7d retention) for sampled_requests, and compact-delta partitions (30d retention) where each delta contains only numeric micro-metrics and dedup keys. Compaction job will collapse consecutive hops with identical selected_tier/model_variant into a single delta segment.

2026-03-06 — Security review note: provenance envelopes will contain model_variant ids and region/tier strings; we flagged PII risk as low but added requirement to scrub user-prompt content and any embedded user identifiers before emitting. KMS-encrypt topic is optional for enterprise customers — extra flag 'encrypted_topic' to be set by private deployments.

2026-03-10 — Design review feedback from PM (Ravi Singh) and Design (Maya Lopez): add UI affordance in Console to expand a sampled envelope into a human-readable timeline and to link to corresponding GitHub PRs for recent model-variant rollouts. Also requested a fallback-cause taxonomy (capacity, model-error, policy-route, region-outage) — added to schema as fallback_reason enum.

2026-03-12 — Implementation: router emits compact envelope by default (micro-metrics only). Background worker will enqueue full snapshot to 'prov.snapshots' when sample hit. In-progress PR: #redwood/prov-ledger PR-412 (instrumentation + producer). Integration tests passing locally; flaky timeout in CI when Kafka cluster GC spikes — infra investigating.
notes: Implementation includes a toggle flag per-customer to control sampling_rate and encrypted_topic. Need follow-up ticket for Console UX wiring and RBAC for access to full snapshots.
follow_up_tasks: Create Console expansion panel for provenance snapshots (PM ticket)

Add rollout: stage sampling at 0.01% -> 0.1% -> 1% with monitoring milestones
